added: packages/assurance: @sos-2/assurance — living AssuranceCase artifacts (spine envelopes, frozen core kind AssuranceCase used as-is) with the exact eight-section content from spec/architecture.md section 5 and docs/assurance-model.md: claims (>= 1), arguments (premises -> conclusion over claims, circularity rejected), assumptions, hazards, controls (addressing hazards), evidence references (evidence id + role SUPPORTS/VERIFIES/CONTRADICTS + claim binding; the same evidence cannot both support and contradict the same claim), validity conditions (the exact recorded IMPLEMENTATION/DEPENDENCY/ENVIRONMENT revisions the case is valid for) and first-class objections (OPEN -> RESOLVED terminal, resolutions require note + instant + provenance); deterministic content-addressed ids (sos://AssuranceCase/<32 hex>); VERDICT IS DERIVED, NEVER STORED (documented design decision: a stored verdict would go stale silently — the point of living assurance)

packages/assurance evaluation: evaluateAssuranceCase(case, { now, systemStateRevision, implementation/dependency/environment revisions, evidence pool, assumption checks }) — deterministic and total; verdicts VALID | OBJECTIONED | INVALID (INVALID dominates OBJECTIONED dominates VALID; unresolved objections surface in the verdict, never silently absorbed into VALID); 15 DISTINCT tracked invalidation reasons: IMPLEMENTATION/DEPENDENCY/ENVIRONMENT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, *_UNREPORTED (an unobserved bound never keeps a case VALID — fail-safe), EVIDENCE_MISSING, EVIDENCE_EXPIRED, EVIDENCE_SUPERSEDED, EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS_UNKNOWN, CONTRADICTED_BY_EVIDENCE (only FRESH contradictions are current), SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_FAILED, SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_INCONCLUSIVE, ASSUMPTION_VIOLATED, ASSUMPTION_UNCHECKED (fail-safe); freshness evaluation DELEGATED to the merged W3 authority (@sos-2/evidence evaluateFreshness — never re-implemented); SUPERSEDED/RETIRED cases never yield verdicts

packages/assurance objections: first-class, recorded, NEVER dropped — sanctioned revision helpers (addObjection, resolveObjection) plus assertValidCaseRevision enforcing objection retention across every direct revision (no removal, no RESOLVED->OPEN regression, no resolution rewriting); every helper output is itself revision-checked

packages/assurance conformance integration: adoptConformanceEvidence consumes the merged conformance evidence kinds (DRIFT_EVIDENCE_KINDS from @sos-2/conformance W2, RUNTIME_CONFORMANCE_EVIDENCE_KIND from @sos-2/runtime-conformance W4 — consumed, never re-declared): drift records document non-conformance and are adoptable ONLY as CONTRADICTS; every other record is keyed on truthful availability (SUPPORTS/VERIFIES requires SUCCESS, CONTRADICTS requires FAILURE, non-conclusive states are adoptable under NO role); adoption appends the evidence reference to the next case revision AND mints the spine trace link evidence.id --role--> new case artifact id through createTraceLink

packages/assurance/fixtures/assurance-case.json: the golden ACTIVE case (id sos://AssuranceCase/cfd0c4d34161d82b443866725f7fc63e) pinned by tests with its deterministic evidence bindings; regeneration documented in fixtures/README.md

packages/assurance/ARCHITECTURE-DELTA.json: this Architecture Delta record — DECLARED HERE because spec/** is outside W8's owned paths; the Architect may reconcile it into spec/contracts/deltas/ at merge time
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace authority: AssuranceCase is one of the 19 frozen core kinds used as-is (no registration, no second kind registry); ids are minted by deriveDeterministicArtifactId over the exact creation address; envelopes come from createEnvelope; trace links from createTraceLink with mandatory provenance

evidence truth states remain 6 distinct states consumed from @sos-2/contracts/@sos-2/semantic-spine — never redefined; evidence freshness is evaluated by the merged W3 authority (@sos-2/evidence evaluateFreshness) and its 4 distinct statuses map to DISTINCT invalidation reasons (EXPIRED_TIME_WINDOW -> EVIDENCE_EXPIRED, SUPERSEDED_SUBJECT_REVISION -> EVIDENCE_SUPERSEDED, UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE -> EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS_UNKNOWN — never collapsed)

Unknown, failed, unavailable and unsupported remain distinct (spec/architecture.md section 18): SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_FAILED and SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_INCONCLUSIVE are separate reasons; the four non-conclusive states are never folded together

fail-safe direction of living assurance: unreported revisions, unchecked assumptions, missing evidence and unevaluable freshness all INVALIDATE — none of them can silently keep a case VALID (an unobserved bound is never treated as a satisfied bound)

objections are first-class and never dropped (W8 acceptance): the revision guard rejects dropped objections, status regressions and resolution rewrites; unresolved objections change the verdict to OBJECTIONED rather than being absorbed

candidate honesty in conformance adoption: drift evidence can never support a claim; non-conclusive evidence can neither support nor contradict — dishonest bindings are rejected loudly at adoption AND independently re-checked at evaluation

the assurance case is declarative content and the verdict is pure derived state (living assurance): evaluate() is deterministic (identical case+input -> byte-identical result), total on valid input, and never uses a hidden clock (now is caller-supplied RFC3339)

no LLM output is authoritative: nothing in this package treats model output as evidence or authorization; evidence records flow in exclusively as W3-minted artifacts with their own producer provenance
boundary_changes: new package boundary: packages/assurance depends on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/evidence, @sos-2/conformance and @sos-2/runtime-conformance (all merged at the W8 base) — consumption only, no modifications to any merged package
